turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Before your exercise, here is one example solved from start to end.
She eats ___ apple. I check the word after the gap: "apple". It starts with the vowel sound "a". So I write "an": She eats an apple.
To sum up: use "an" when the next sound is a vowel sound, and "a" for other sounds.
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: I have an pen.
Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
